summary: 蓝牙耳机多SKU混合发品 — 信息甄别与矛盾处理 — alibaba_publish mock. v2: 4 structural + 1 image + 23 field atomic checks.
check_strategy: private/expected_answer.json drives per-field validation; the shared verifier bench_core.verifiers.alibaba_publish_v2 folds the atomic results into capability buckets per docs/check-granularity.md (R2: 4 structural checks → setup_gate; R3: image slots and each same-skill field group collapse to one check; R7: one shared verifier covers all 12 alibaba_publish tasks). Each bucket = AND of its present member fields (failures listed in the reason). Binary pass = all buckets, which is identical to all atoms (pure aggregation). Only buckets with >=1 present field are emitted for this product.

checks.description: Plumbing folded into one gate: a session exists, its state is readable, status == 'submitted', and the access-log has a legitimate cli_submit_valid (Bearer-token CLI path) event for it.
All required image slots carry a correct uploaded file (collapsed upload-skill batch; multi-image products validate correct/acceptable files and reject wrong files).
category + saleMode + productGroup all correct (catalog placement / sale mode).
productTitle and keyword_1..3 all correct (SEO title + keywords).
All attr_* product attributes correct (read the spec → map to closed-set attribute values).
All pricing / trade-term fields correct (saleType, priceUnit, priceMode, fob*, minOrderQuantity, inventory, ladderPrice, countryPriceDiff).

notes: Total checks = 8 (setup_gate + images_correct + 6 skill buckets). Restructured 2026-06-08 from the previous per-field atomic layout (4 structural + image + N field_* — e.g. led-bulb 33). Pure aggregation: no validation loosened, binary pass unchanged; capacity now reflects distinct capability units. Mode: cli uses cli_submit_valid.
